decisions.reason: Lack of negative results and low incremental cost of a hearty bread close to the core keep the option alive.
The sweet pastry is close to established products and shows no sign that its value has resolved negatively, so the firm retains this low-cost option.
Although it may overlap with other breads, it is core-adjacent and inexpensive to maintain, so the option is still worth keeping.
As the flagship with a gold award, its value has resolved favorably and it aligns with the firm's strategic direction, making a drop very unlikely.
The premium stollen's gold award signals realized value, and despite seasonal costs it still justifies continued commitment.
